newsitem.title: DUBAI: Qatar says raises September crudes prices.
newsitem.headline: Qatar says raises September crudes prices.

text.p: The Qatar General Petroleum Corporation (QGPC) said on Sunday it increased the price of its crudes lifted in September to $21.75 per barrel for Qatar Land and $21.66 for Qatar Marine.
QGPC's move follows a decision by Oman on Sunday to increase its September prices by $1.60 to $21.20 per barrel.
The Qatar News Agency reported that the QGPC's September prices were $1.82 higher for both grades than in August. --
